original_claims.claim: 30 human participants were trained on four person-to-animal-and-vegetable deterministic association mapping; each person has unique vegetable and one shared animal for a pair
original_claims.original_primary_locator: Original final Fig2 and task Methods

original_claims.claim: Each bandit choice presents a random pair of people with 2s choice limit and observed animal/vegetable rewards weighted 3 and 1 respectively

Across 300 bandit trials, every 10 bandit trials is followed by two reward-settings, total 60 reward-setting trials, allowing choice of .75/.25 vegetable probability among same-animal shared-person pair
Animal and vegetable reward probabilities externally drift via independent Gaussian random walks reflected in [.25,.75], following subject's immediate setting of two vegetable probabilities
Fixed MF caches Q^MF value of each person and updates only selected person's Q based on total animal+vegetable reward prediction error; unchosen persons decay toward default
MB maintains learned outcome-specific animal and vegetable Q^MB and recomputes person value via their two associated outcomes; observed animal updates generalize to another same-animal person
MB outcome values of unobserved animals/vegetables decay toward original initialized defaults, and reward-setting chosen vegetable probability updates MB Q after setting
Bandit choice net value combines MB and MF contributions with weighted choice trace and constant three individual-specific biases, then softmax
Bandit choice traces C(person) update recency/frequency after each bandit and permit perseverance or novelty according to sign of trace weight
MF reward-setting system maintains two cached setting Q^MF,rs values; all ten subsequent bandit total rewards update selected setting Q with lambda^(i−1) decay, plus independent reward-setting trace
An MF-ignorant Bellman planner is indifferent between the tested exchange-symmetric same-animal paired vegetable reward settings under identical future opportunity assumptions
The proposed self-reflective MB planner uses relative Q^MF preference for future bandit people when preferring to set .75 vegetable reward for person with stronger MF disposition
original_claims.original_primary_locator: Original Fig4B, Methods net reward-setting Q

original_claims.claim: A lazy MB encoder prefers reward setting aligned to currently high MB vegetable value, avoiding expected remapping/encoding cost and is modeled separately from reflection
Reward-setting net Q additionally includes MF reward-setting Q, lazy encoder, self-reflective planning, reward-setting trace, individual bandit trace, constant bandit bias, followed by softmax

Bandit population signatures: immediate same-animal repetition favors previous animal reward MF effect while same-animal different-person generalization after controlling outcome probability supports MB
Experimental high/low/unrelated bandit trial categories are relative to the preceding reward-setting label, not guaranteed continuously higher/lower true vegetable probabilities under drift

For animal reward among the ten post-setting trials the self-reflective path predicts High>Unrelated>Low effect on later repeat setting while direct MF reward-setting path boosts all categories and lazy MB is isolated by animal-only analysis
Original empirically observed fixed-effect contrasts show High vs Low and High vs Unrelated differences; raw participant trials and exact regressions not reproduced by W3
Full fitted RL and no-self-reflective gamma_selfref=0 nested variant generate different synthetic reward-setting contrast profiles in original reported model simulations
Original fitting used 200 initial points/person two waves: nine bandit parameters fit from bandit choices first then seven setting parameters conditional on first-wave fits
original_claims.original_primary_locator: Original Methods Model fitting and comparison

original_claims.claim: Original correlation between fitted gamma_selfref and median reward-setting RT Spearman rho=.5 p=.005 is convergent correlation not direct direct measurement of internal self-model content
Original parameter-tradeoff bootstrap preserved fitted gamma_selfref vs MF contribution p=.002 but MB contribution p=.06, so latter not significant after parameter-tradeoff check

Paper explicitly notes formation, maintenance, mental/brain instantiation and potential cheaper heuristics for inferred self-model remain unresolved; no direct self model formation mechanism specified

Paper explicitly traces earlier 2019 same-author retrospective MB inference helping MF credit assignment and Daw/Niv/Dayan 2005 generic MB/MF competition, but future environment reward-setting differs mechanistically from retrospective updates

Final published source main 28pp plus actual same-article S5/S6 visual model recovery and S1 fit percentile table are physically verified; original task instruction PPTX are excluded from exact participant fidelity scope
